test_cases.description: verifyManifestComponentBijection must correctly report both missingInMap and extraInMap simultaneously when manifest and map have non-overlapping keys, not just one direction at a time
assertions: result.missingInMap contains keys from manifest not in map
result.extraInMap contains keys from map not in manifest

test_cases.description: verifyManifestComponentBijection must handle an empty manifest array against a non-empty component map, reporting all map keys as extraInMap
verifyManifestComponentBijection must handle a non-empty manifest against an empty component map, reporting all manifest keys as missingInMap

verifyManifestComponentBijection must correctly extract manifestKeys preserving order and duplicates from the manifest entries, since the contract says 'componentKey from every manifest entry in order'
assertions: result.manifestKeys reflects every entry's componentKey in order, including duplicates

test_cases.description: verifyManifestComponentBijection must return manifestKeys in the same order as the manifest entries appear, not sorted or deduplicated
verifyManifestComponentBijection must return mapKeys containing every key from the componentMap object, not just ones matching PageComponentKey enum values
assertions: result.mapKeys includes arbitrary string keys from the map

test_cases.description: bootstrapApp must dynamically set BootstrapResult.targetElementId from the config parameter, not hardcode 'root' or any other string
assertions: result.targetElementId === config.targetElementId for a non-default ID like 'my-app-container'

test_cases.description: bootstrapApp must throw manifest_component_mismatch when the page component map has extra keys not present in the manifest, even if all manifest keys ARE present in the map
assertions: mismatch detected even though no manifest key is missing from map

test_cases.description: bootstrapApp must not call renderEntryPoint when bijection verification fails, confirming the ordering invariant that verification precedes rendering
bootstrapApp must not call renderEntryPoint when the target DOM element is missing, confirming DOM check happens before render attempt
Every path in the route manifest must start with '/' as required by RoutePath validation — ensures path format is not just checked for uniqueness but for structure
Every path in the route manifest must contain only lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and forward slashes per RoutePath specification
Every label in the route manifest must be a non-empty string, ensuring RouteLabel validation is enforced for all 13 entries
Every value in the page component map must be a function (React.ComponentType), not a string, object, or other non-callable value
assertions: typeof value === 'function' for every entry in the map

test_cases.description: Every RouteEntry in the manifest must have exactly the three required fields: path, label, and componentKey — no missing fields
bootstrapApp must call getRouteManifest and getPageComponentMap exactly once per invocation even when called multiple times sequentially, ensuring no caching or state leakage between calls
assertions: after two calls, getRouteManifest called exactly 2 times total
after two calls, getPageComponentMap called exactly 2 times total

test_cases.description: verifyManifestComponentBijection with an empty manifest and an empty component map should return isValid true since both sets are identical (empty)
getProjectManifest must return a manifest whose files array contains exactly 12 entries, matching the ScaffoldFilePath enum cardinality
getProjectManifest must return a manifest with a non-empty projectRoot string
getRequiredDependencies must return an object with both dependencies and devDependencies arrays, each containing entries with packageName, versionRange, and isDev fields
bootstrapApp should reject a targetElementId that is whitespace-only since such an ID would fail DOM lookup, either through validation or target_element_not_found
verifyManifestComponentBijection must work correctly with a single-entry manifest matching a single-key map, not just hardcoded for 13 entries
bootstrapApp must propagate render_failure error even when bijection verification succeeds, confirming the error path is not short-circuited by prior success
assertions: render_failure error is thrown by bootstrapApp
